name: segmented-control
title: SegmentedControl
description: A single-choice toggle rendered as adjacent segments — a compact radio group for switching a view (List / Board, Day / Week / Month). Uses the radiogroup pattern (Arrow keys move and select); distinct from <Tabs>, which navigates between panels, and from <Select>, which is for longer lists.
